user_intent: Review and, if valid, land a minimal fix for the mismatch between Implementation Agent placeholder guidance and Patch Compiler placeholder detection.
title: Align Patch Compiler placeholder marker detection with Implementation Agent contract
description: The Implementation Agent role prompt and retry guidance forbid TODO and prose placeholders such as other code unchanged, but Patch Compiler PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS currently does not reject those forms. A testing agent documented the current slip-through behavior as strict xfail and exported a proposed patch. This request records the owner-requested review and minimal production-code alignment before modifying patch_compiler.py.
expected_artifacts: Updated PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS with precise forbidden placeholder forms
Updated regression tests turning the documented xfail gap into normal passing assertions
Validation results from targeted pytest, full pytest, compileall, and abyss_cli check

request_fields.activation_policy: delayed; candidate material only until owner review and normal ChangeSet boundaries
request_fields.affected_governance_surface: Patch Compiler validation for Implementation Agent edit-plan content; this changes rejection criteria for placeholder-like content but does not change approval, apply, dry-run, path, or owner-authority policy.
request_fields.current_problem: Current placeholder detection rejects existing code / placeholder / omitted / ellipsis forms, while runtime prompt and retry guidance also forbid TODO and other code unchanged. Tests show create_file content containing '# TODO: fill this in' or '// other code unchanged' currently compiles to a proposed ChangeSet rather than invalid format feedback.
request_fields.owner_authority_impact: No reduction or delegation of Owner authority. The change only makes compiler validation stricter for already-forbidden placeholder forms; it does not grant execution or approval authority.
request_fields.old_rule_review: Prior rules require changes touching agent contracts or self-iteration validation boundaries to be recorded before modification. This request records the review and keeps execution within existing compiler/test validation boundaries.
request_fields.risk_assessment: Main risk is false positives if placeholder markers are too broad. Mitigation: use precise forms such as todo:, # todo, // todo, other code unchanged, code unchanged, and ellipsis placeholder rather than a bare todo substring.
request_fields.rollback_plan: Revert the PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS additions and restore the two tests to strict xfail if the stricter validation proves too broad.
request_fields.validation_plan: Run the adversarial parser tests, compileall, full pytest, and abyss_cli check.
request_fields.proposed_change: Add precise TODO/prose-placeholder forms to PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS and convert the previously strict-xfail slip-through tests into normal rejection assertions. Keep the testing agent's proposal patch as review evidence; do not rely on git apply because the exported patch is not valid plain-text patch input.

warnings: artifacts/drafts/placeholder_markers_proposal.patch appears to be encoded with NUL bytes and is not directly accepted by git apply --check; use it as review evidence rather than direct patch input.
notes: This request is created before modifying production code, per the owner's meta-iteration requirement.
